786:   def pbStartTerrain(user, newTerrain, fixedDuration = true)
787:     return if @field.terrain == newTerrain
788:     @field.terrain = newTerrain
789:     duration = (fixedDuration) ? 5 : -1
790:     if duration > 0 && user && user.itemActive?
791:       duration = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerTerrainExtender(user.item, newTerrain,
792:                                                             duration, user, self)
793:     end
794:     @field.terrainDuration = duration
795:     terrain_data = GameData::BattleTerrain.try_get(@field.terrain)
796:     pbCommonAnimation(terrain_data.animation) if terrain_data
797:     pbHideAbilitySplash(user) if user
798:     case @field.terrain
799:     when :Electric
800:       pbDisplay(_INTL("An electric current runs across the battlefield!"))
801:     when :Grassy
802:       pbDisplay(_INTL("Grass grew to cover the battlefield!"))
803:     when :Misty
804:       pbDisplay(_INTL("Mist swirled about the battlefield!"))
805:     when :Psychic
806:       pbDisplay(_INTL("The battlefield got weird!"))
807:     end
808:     # Check for abilities/items that trigger upon the terrain changing
809:     allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbAbilityOnTerrainChange }
810:     allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbItemTerrainStatBoostCheck }
811:   end
